mapper.select: select count(*) total_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN accept_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS covered_count from om_target ot where ot.del_flag =0 and ot.valid_flag = 1 and ot.version_id = #{versionId}
select count(*) from om_term t where t.del_flag =0 and t.valid_flag = 1 and t.version_id = #{versionId}
select count(*) from om_enum_type oet where oet.del_flag =0 and oet.valid_flag = 1 and oet.version_id = #{versionId}
select count(*) from om_object_type oot where oot.del_flag =0 and oot.valid_flag = 1 and oot.version_id = #{versionId}
select count(*) from om_object_type_attribute oota where oota.del_flag =0 and oota.valid_flag = 1 and oota.version_id = #{versionId}
select count(*) from om_object_type_relation ootr where ootr.del_flag =0 and ootr.valid_flag = 1 and ootr.version_id = #{versionId}
